feed.headline: Embattled Spanish PM insists no prior warnings before Ceuta crisis
feed.ai: Spain's prime minister tells parliament it is absurd to think the government knew and did nothing, after thousands join protests in Spanish cities.

feed.headline: Netherlands moves billions in gold to London in 'crisis preparedness' move
feed.ai: The Dutch central bank removes some of its gold reserves from the US and Canada, saying it is because of "increasing geopolitical unrest".

feed.headline: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
feed.ai: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.

feed.headline: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
feed.ai: The Russian president wants to keep Britain guessing - and stressing - over Moscow's real intentions.

feed.headline: Why is Ukraine's ex-defence minister calling for wartime elections?
feed.ai: Mykhailo Fedorov has called for elections, without addressing concerns over how they could be held while at war.

feed.headline: Trump Envoys Arrive in Moscow for Talks on Ukraine War
feed.ai: Steve Witkoff, President Trump’s special envoy, and Jared Kushner, his son-in-law, plan to visit Kyiv next, in an effort to revive peace negotiations between Russia and Ukraine.

feed.headline: Germany’s Far Right, Edging Close to Power, Remains Close to Extremists
feed.ai: The Alternative for Germany party has tried to soften its hard-line image but is still privately working with extremists. It could win a state election on Sunday.

feed.headline: Argentina Is Ramping Up Its Claim to the Falklands. Here’s What to Know.
feed.ai: President Javier Milei has dialed up Argentina’s claim over the British territory, while President Trump has raised questions about longstanding U.S. neutrality on the dispute.

feed.headline: Dutch Central Bank Cuts Gold Reserves in U.S., Citing ‘Geopolitical Unrest’
feed.ai: The Netherlands moved some 90 tons of gold out of the Federal Reserve Bank in New York, the second European nation this year to announce it had decreased or eliminated U.S. gold holdings.

feed.headline: Spain’s Leader Questions Morocco Border Control During Ceuta Migrant Surge
feed.ai: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of Spain said the role of Moroccan authorities at key moments needed to be “clarified.” But he rejected any suggestion they had planned the crisis.

feed.headline: Rival Ukrainian Intelligence Units Open Fire Against Each Other in Kyiv
feed.ai: President Volodymyr Zelensky described the shootout on the streets of the Ukrainian capital as an “absolutely shameful event” and ordered an investigation.

feed.headline: Meloni marks government longevity at Bari rally with 2027 vote in sight
feed.ai: The durability of Meloni’s coalition has been a rarity in postwar Italy, where governments have often fallen before the end of their mandates.
